validation_evidence.statement: LightGBM SMOTE has the higher validation AP among the two primary candidates.

calibration.interpretation: Calibration is treated as a probability representation layer rather than as an improvement in ranking performance.

research_conclusion: Both LightGBM SMOTE and XGBoost provide strong chronological fraud-detection performance.
LightGBM SMOTE has higher validation AP, which is the pre-established primary model-selection metric.
XGBoost has a slightly higher AP on the untouched test set, but this test result is not used to retroactively select the model.
XGBoost isotonic calibration improves probability quality on the untouched test set according to Brier score and LogLoss, while reducing AP and ROC-AUC relative to raw XGBoost probabilities.
Therefore detection/ranking and probability calibration remain separate system layers.
Operational thresholds are validation-derived and frozen before test evaluation.
